mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parking_log ( vehicle_img, license_plate_img, license_plate_country, country_accuracy, vehicle_num, ocr_accuracy, is_ev_license_plate, entry_time, is_member, is_paid, del ) VALUES ( #{vehicleImg}, #{licensePlateImg}, #{licensePlateCountry}, #{countryAccuracy}, #{vehicleNum}, #{ocrAccuracy}, #{isEvLicensePlate}, NOW(), #{isMember}, false, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, a.emp_number AS empNumber, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(p.exit_time, NOW()) - p.entry_time))/60 AS duration FROM parking_log p LEFT JOIN admin_staff a ON p.admin_staff_id = a.admin_staff_id WHERE vehicle_num = #{vehicleNum} AND exit_time IS NULL AND del = 0 ORDER BY entry_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE parking_log SET exit_time = NOW(), is_member = #{isMember}, parking_fee = #{parkingFee}, is_paid = #{isPaid}, pay_type = #{payType} WHERE parking_log_id = #{parkingLogId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, a.emp_number AS empNumber, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(p.exit_time, NOW()) - p.entry_time))/60 AS duration FROM parking_log p LEFT JOIN admin_staff a ON p.admin_staff_id = a.admin_staff_id WHERE p.del = 0 ORDER BY p.entry_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE parking_log SET vehicle_num = #{vehicleNum}, license_plate_country = #{licensePlateCountry}, admin_staff_id = #{adminStaffId}, is_modified = TRUE, modify_time = NOW() WHERE parking_log_id = #{parkingLogId}
UPDATE parking_log SET del = 1, admin_staff_id = #{adminStaffId}, modify_time = NOW() WHERE parking_log_id = #{parkingLogId}
